trainer.startBody: A symbol and a date are drawn from your universe. Candles print one at a time. Read the structure, place the invalidation, then let the tape resolve.
trainer.judgingHint: Tip: press 1–4 for state, L/S for direction, Space to wait one bar.
trainer.planningHint: Drag the entry, stop and target lines on the chart, or type exact ticks. The stop should sit beyond structure.

read.hint: State first, direction second. Trend trades only go with the trend.
read.thesisPlaceholder: If I showed this to another trader, could they reproduce my entry?
read.thesisHint: Name the level, the trigger, and why the invalidation belongs where it does.
read.counterTrendLock: Counter-trend direction is locked while you call a {state}.

plan.title: Place the invalidation before the entry.
plan.hint: Drag the lines on the chart or type exact prices. A stop belongs beyond structure, not at your comfort level.

check.stop_side: Stop is on the losing side of the entry.
check.target_side: Target is on the winning side of the entry.
check.stop_tooTight: Stop is {atr} ATR away — inside the noise.
check.stop_tooWide: Stop is {atr} ATR away — wider than the structure.
check.stop_structure: Stop is {atr} ATR from the nearest swing. Place it beyond the swing.
check.target_structure: Target is {atr} ATR from the nearest swing. Anchor it to structure.
check.rr_unrealistic: R:R is {rr}:1 — beyond what this tape usually delivers.
check.risk_tooSmall: One contract risks more than your per-trade budget.
check.levels_missing: Entry, stop and target are all required.

plan.standAsideBody: You called a tape you would not trade. The round will resolve without an order, and the process score will judge the read.
plan.standAsideNote: No fills, no fees, no fake activity.

ticket.title: Trade ticket
ticket.positionOpen: A position is open. Manage it below before placing another order.
ticket.footnote: Simulated fills at bar close. Stop and target are brackets.
ticket.sheetNote: Risk first. Size is derived from your stop and per-trade budget.

rules.title: Account guardrails
rules.breached: Guardrail breached — this round is locked.

review.title: The tape is unblind.
review.noPlan: No plan was committed, so there is no process grade. The reveal is still the lesson.
review.standAsideBody: You stood aside on a {regime} tape. Standing aside is a valid answer — the review is your read, not your P&L.

state.partial: State was adjacent, not clean. The tape was {actual}.
state.opposite: State was the opposite of the tape ({actual}).

direction.noneValid: Standing aside was valid in this tape.
direction.noneTrend: A trend was available; you chose not to take it.
direction.chop: Directional trade in {actual}; this tape punishes that.
direction.counterTrend: Counter-trend entry against a clean trend.

stop.tooTight: Stop sat {atr} ATR from entry — inside the noise.
stop.insideNoise: Stop sat {atr} ATR from the nearest swing, not beyond it.

rr.unrealistic: Reward-to-risk was {rr}:1; structure did not support that reach.

thesis.thin: The thesis was too thin to reproduce.

waited.none: You acted on the first bar without waiting for the setup.

risk.exceeded: The stop required more risk than the per-trade budget allows.

outcome.noFill: Entry never triggered. No fill, no fee.

settings.languageNote: English is the source language. Translations preserve trading terms.

drill.title: Read it before you trade it.
drill.subtitle: One hidden sample. Commit the state, the direction and the invalidation. The grade weighs the process, not the P&L.
drill.blindHint: Candles print one at a time. Use Space to wait for the setup.
drill.revealHint: The future is revealed. Pan and zoom to inspect what happened after your plan.

daily.subtitle: One hidden sample seeded by the UTC date. Commit a read and a plan, then compare it with deterministic reference plans.
daily.lockTitle: The symbol, the date and the next 500 bars are locked.
daily.lockBody: Everyone who opens Prop Desk today gets the same tape. You see 150 bars and no ticker. Read it, place the invalidation, commit — the reveal and the reference board unlock after submission.
daily.boardDisclaimer: Reference plans are deterministic strategy baselines computed on this sample. They are not real traders, and they are not a leaderboard of people.

how.title: How the daily works
how.one: The sample is derived from the UTC date, so it is identical for every player.
how.two: You get one submission per day. Symbol, date and the future are revealed after it.
how.three: The score weighs state, direction, plan structure and discipline — not the P&L.
how.note: Changing your instrument universe does not change the daily sample.

history.title: Last 7 days
history.note: A dot means no submission that day. Grades are stored locally in this browser.

daily.title: Same tape. Same rules.

lobby.subcopy: Hidden instrument. Hidden date. One bar at a time. Build the only edge that survives an evaluation: a repeatable process under uncertainty.

universe.title: Prop-firm favourites, micros first.
universe.hint: Pick the contracts you actually trade. Every sample is drawn from this list; the symbol stays hidden until review.

how.title: Four moves, repeated until they are boring.

read.title: Read the state
read.body: Call the tape before the trade. Trend trades only go with the trend.

plan.title: Place the invalidation
plan.body: Stop beyond structure, target at the next level, size from the risk budget.

run.title: Let the tape speak
run.body: One bar at a time. No rewinds, no indicator shopping, no second opinions.

review.title: Grade the process
review.body: Read, plan and discipline are scored separately from the P&L.

rules.title: Simulated guardrails, real consequences.
rules.subtitle: The account rules match the way evaluations actually fail: drawdown, daily loss, and a target you have to reach without giving it back.

drawdown.title: Trailing drawdown
drawdown.body: The floor follows your equity high. Give back {pct}% from the peak and the account is done.

daily.title: Daily loss limit
daily.body: Down {pct}% in one session and trading locks. No revenge trades, no averaging out.

target.title: Profit target
target.body: Reach {pct}% and the evaluation passes. Keep the process intact on the way there.

daily.title: One sample. Same for everyone.
daily.body: A single hidden scenario seeded by today's date. The symbol, the date and the next 500 bars unlock after you commit.

recent.title: Your last three sessions
recent.empty: No sessions yet. Your first round writes this page — the chart does not care how you feel about it.

discipline.title: A green P&L can still be a bad trade.
discipline.body: The drill grades the read and the plan independently of the outcome, so a lucky win cannot hide a counter-trend entry.

footer.disclaimer: Prop Desk is a training tool. All series are simulated, no live market data is used, and nothing here is financial advice.
